) and Crossover Markets on Monday said institutional clients have surpassed $2 billion in cumulative notional volume executed on Crossover Markets’ CROSSx and cleared and settled through BitGo’s Go Network.

BitGo and Crossover Markets launched their relationship in 2025 to provide institutional clients with electronic execution on CROSSx, with BitGo serving as the central counterparty for clearing and settlement through Go Network under a single credit relationship.

title: BitGo and Crossover Markets surpass $2B in cleared volume
